maria: quick PR to add a tiny "reserved-pool" quickstart, + a short section on autoscale cooldown defaults. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012

leo: can we include a short Rust snippet? infra folks requested one.

maria: added a minimal Rust example and an HCL Terraform snippet. keeping examples intentionally tiny.

anjali: nit: use `min_replicas`/`max_replicas` in examples (matches SDK and TF naming). also change isolation value to `tenant_level`.

maria: done. added a one-line rationale under cooldown: "short cooldown favours rapid scale-up but risks oscillation under spiky traffic".

docs-bot: docs CI started -> https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/43900

leo: linted the snippets locally, looks fine. lgtm after CI. i'll merge and add a changelog note for dedicated docs.
